sources.verbatim: (1) Any use will be permitted provided it fulfils the requirements of this "Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0". (2) The user must ensure that the source note contains the following information: the name of the provider, the annotation "Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0" or "dl-de/by-2-0" referring to the licence text available at www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0, and a reference to the dataset (URI).
